question: Do the newly nominated Rochelle sequencing deposits expose biological identities and assay/time joins needed by A8 and the related A19 question?
decision: Determine which source labels are directly available and which preparation, early/later endpoint and receptor/reserve mappings still require qualification.
strongest_rival: Repeated donor labels or embedded title codes may describe different preparations, multiplexed samples or endpoints, not a linked biological experiment.
discriminator: Report each GSM record with verbatim title and characteristic fields; preserve absent or conflicting individual labels rather than inferring biological units.
exposure_record: The article, support-workbook labels and first SOFT sample headers were read before this freeze. No expression matrix or new biological effect has been fitted.
biological_unit: Human donor and independently identified preparation; GSM and donor labels are metadata observations, not confirmed independent units.
nesting_and_overlap: Samples may share donors or pool scaffold regions. Donor1-style labels are not automatically aliases for article donor codes or cross-study matches.
population_and_selection: All SAMPLE records from the two saved GSE306194 and GSE306714 family SOFT files; no expression-based selection.
contrast: Source-declared labels and missing fields across the two deposits; no biological between-group contrast.
endpoint: Verbatim sample metadata, explicit individual-label sets and counts of records without explicit individual characteristics.
methods: Parse series/sample SOFT entities; reject duplicate accessions or missing titles; retain multi-valued characteristics and embedded title codes without splitting into inferred units.
missingness_and_exclusions: Absent individual/group fields remain empty; no donor, state, preparation, timing or lineage map is imputed.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests, p-values, score selection or effect calculations.
precision_basis: Deterministic source-label recovery only; biological effect margins and independent-unit variance are not assessed.
interpretation_limit: Recovered sample and donor labels do not establish independent preparations, same-lineage early/later linkage, mature function, receptor-specific withdrawal or retained reserve.
stop_rule: Stop on changed source hashes, duplicate sample identifiers, wrong series or missing titles. Hold the biological comparison until its actual unit/endpoint joins are supplied.
amendment_reason: Initial prospective metadata execution for two new candidate deposits, distinct from the completed earlier GEO/BioSample sources and from exposed article reading.
